Summary of .agents/skills/rest-conventions/SKILL.md in OtterWorks. The billing OpenAPI contract (services/legacy-billing/openapi/billing-v1.yaml) is the source of truth.

  • Public APIs use /api/v1/<service-area>; the gateway forwards the full path unchanged and billing requires JWT authentication.
  • Use plural, lower-case kebab-case resource nouns, at most two nesting levels, snake_case parameters and JSON fields. A resource's identifier is id; references keep resource_id. GET never changes state; send JSON request bodies and explicit required business inputs.
  • Use UUID strings, decimal strings for money, YYYY-MM-DD dates and RFC 3339 timestamps.
  • Return data envelopes; collections also have pagination with limit (default 50, range 1–200) and opaque cursor, ending with next_cursor null. Reads return 200, creation 201 with Location when addressable, deletion 204.
  • Errors use error.code, message and optional field details; clients branch on code. Distinguish invalid input (400), authentication (401), missing resources (404), conflicts (409), rejected database constraints (422), rate limiting (429 with Retry-After) and generic internal/upstream errors without SQL or stack traces.
  • Within v1 allow additive changes only; breaking changes need v2 while v1 remains available. Deprecated legacy routes keep exact bodies and status codes, adding Deprecation and successor-version Link headers.
  • Implement versioned handlers over the database entrypoints, with legacy routes as thin adapters. Contract tests compare fresh seeded states through explicitly declared renames and status mappings, including mutations and errors; run make billing-contract.

The mapping work will fill this page in later.

Sources: Db2 CUSTMAST, Oracle ACCOUNTS and PostgreSQL crm.contacts → MongoDB target.

The customer document shape remains an open question. No mapping or document model has been decided.
